errors.evidence: The description claims the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically, but they are not (Malta, Luxembourg, Cyprus, Belgium...). They seem to be sorted in descending order of the 2008 value.
The description states the color for the year 2008 is light green, but the legend and bars in the chart clearly show it as blue/teal.

errors.text_span: За някои държави, като например Исландия и Косово, стойността за 2008 г. е отбелязана като прекъсната поради надвишаване на горната граница на скалата.
errors.evidence: The description invents a feature that does not exist. No bars are cut for exceeding the upper limit. The bars for Norway are cut for being far below the lower limit, and there is no cut bar for Iceland or Kosovo.

The description fails to mention two critical pieces of information explained in the footnotes: that the bars for Norway are cut due to very large negative values (footnote 1) and that 2008 data is unavailable for several countries, including Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, and Kosovo (footnote 2).
